item.text: I’ll write the files, read the nonce in a separate shell call, and silently verify the checkpoint.

item.command: "C:\\Program Files\\PowerShell\\7\\pwsh.exe" -Command '$checkpointText = '"'{\"current_claim\": \"The smoke file was written and read back.\", \"evidence_paths\": [\"probe-evidence.txt\"], \"attempts\": [\"Write and read the nonce file.\"], \"remaining_work\": [], \"next_step\": \"Return the maintenance response.\", \"progress_state\": \"ready_to_submit\"}'; "'$checkpointPath = Join-Path (Get-Location) '"'checkpoint.json'; [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText("'$checkpointPath, $checkpointText, [System.Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false)); $actualCheckpoint = [System.IO.File]::ReadAllText($checkpointPath, [System.Text.Encoding]::UTF8) | ConvertFrom-Json; $expectedCheckpoint = $checkpointText | ConvertFrom-Json; if (($actualCheckpoint | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 10 -Compress) -cne ($expectedCheckpoint | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 10 -Compress)) { throw '"'Checkpoint verification failed' }"
